pages.title: Dyson Swarm Satellite
pages.text: One collector out of millions that together surround a star in a cloud. Each one harvests a sliver of starlight, computes its own position and beams the energy home. It is a small, neat thing, but many of them together can catch a star.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Solar Statites could hover, but not steer or transmit. In the Metamaterial Weaver I gave each one a Quantum Processor and a superconducting coil, and they began organising themselves into a swarm.
Made in $(item)Metamaterial Weaver$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Dyson Swarm.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dyson Array, Von Neumann Probe.
